value: Muradin receives the dull training sword he once used with Arthas in Lordaeron. Its blunted edge bears none of the blood of later wars, yet its weight draws back days of teaching and regret. Muradin wonders how events might have changed had he stopped Arthas from discovering Frostmourne. A practice blade from an earlier life becomes the part of Arthas he mourns: a young man still being taught.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
